name: CSV Contract Preflight MCP
tagline: Inspect CSV contract rules, then buy a $0.01 validation report.
description: Linux/Python3.11+ local stdio engineering preview. Twelve tools cover free offer/template inspection, explicit contract review and acceptance, and separately authorized Apify report purchase/retrieval. Completed pass and findings reports each cost$0.01 using the buyer's own eligible Apify account; custom proposal generation uses the caller's own model. Native limits:20,000 UTF-8 CSV bytes,500 data records,64 columns and8,000 contract bytes. Supports string/integer fields, required values, exact header order and literal string/composite keys. No repair, import authorization or source-truth guarantee. Offer metadata is a static reference, not a live quote. See the linked README for privacy, recovery and platform limitations.

env.name: APIFY_TOKEN
env.description: Your own eligible Apify buyer token for buyer-profile drafts and paid reports; omit for free offer/template inspection.

install.notes: Requires Linux, Python3.11+, uv and Git. Installs immutable public0.4 source. Free inspection needs no token. Configure an optional buyer token privately through your client before authorized buyer operations; do not put it in tool arguments. Report purchases and model/provider costs are separate. Preserve private operation state for uncertain-start recovery. No Windows/macOS compatibility is claimed.
